name: Krakatau, Sunda Strait
region: Sunda Strait between Java and Sumatra
summary: Volcanic island complex in the Sunda Strait between Java and Sumatra. The catastrophic 1883 eruption and caldera collapse generated destructive tsunamis affecting nearby coastlines.
uncertainty: Coordinates are intentionally omitted from v0.1 because the event involves a changing volcanic island/caldera complex rather than a single immutable point.
